job.name: ig8_cover
job.person_note: The woman must be exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, long straight dark-brown hair, cream turtleneck).
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER for a self-help coach video: a photorealistic frame of exactly the woman from the attached photo in her calm light room with a big window at dusk, looking at the viewer with a confident warm expression. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: a huge white bold sans-serif title with a thin black outline in three lines «7 ПРАВИЛ,» / «ЧТОБЫ ВСЕЛЕННАЯ» / «ПОМОГАЛА», with «7» very large and the word «ВСЕЛЕННАЯ» in light sky-blue #6ECDFF. No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no handles. High contrast, readable at small size in the profile grid.
job.style_qa: обложка с ведущей из приложенного фото (узнаваема, не искажена), надпись «7 ПРАВИЛ, ЧТОБЫ ВСЕЛЕННАЯ ПОМОГАЛА» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The woman from the chest up in the lower 60% of the frame, centred. The title sits in the upper part, centred, starting about 18% below the top edge and inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid; the title never covers her face.
